_comment: Approved series-ticker allowlist for the five focus topics. A market whose series ticker appears here is classified with the method 'series-allowlist' and the evidence is the ticker itself, which makes the scope of the dashboard auditable. Add entries only after a human has reviewed the series and its title. Example shape: { "KXGASREGULAR": "gas" }. The topic must be one of: gas, elections, culture, crypto, golf.
